name: Paracas
blurb: Conversation about Paracas is up 258% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
